title: I Forwarded the Car-Share Overnight Ping After They Kept My Reserved Hatch

parts.text: I unlocked hatch 8 at 7:02 a.m. and member Rafi's app still showed my unpaid-looking leftover trip. The screen said: END THE TRIP. RETURN THE BAY. NO OVERNIGHT KEEPS. I was twenty-nine, renter, holding a reservation. Rafi had parked it at a cousin's. I photographed the screen, the empty bay, and the ping. Then I forwarded overnight. At 7:09 support asked why Rafi's name was on my hatch. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. I have learned the difference between a title and a line item.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: Support can see Rafi's leftover trip on hatch 8 during my reservation.

social.video_title: They kept my reserved car-share hatch overnight at a cousin's — Part 1/2
social.description: Car share, an empty bay, an overnight ping. I forwarded the trip. Would you have messaged support?

parts.text: Rafi called it a buffer until support asked for the still. I printed the ping, the screen, and the reservation. He ended the trip. Rafi booked his own hours and told members buffers were always about optics. Optics is a word keepers use when bays exist. Return now has a second line: TRIPS END IN THE BAY. I keep hatch 8. Rafi brown-bags the jokes. The stall finally looks like a reservation, not a driveway. The rule looks ordinary now, which is the whole point.

social.video_title: Trips end in the bay — Part 2/2
social.description: Overnight ping, ended trip, and a second line. Was a buffer ever my hatch?
